correctness.rationale: All essential numeric claims replay bit-for-bit. Ran inputs/artifacts/verify.py: 44/44 count files PASS slice identities c_k+n_k=C(m,k), totals 2^m, stored exact probabilities (Fraction recomputation), monotonicity; duality XOR exhaustive on 3x4 (2^19 configs) PASS; all 8 window inequalities PASS as exact Fraction comparisons (e.g. 4x6-H P0.44=0.2355825...<=1/4, P0.56=0.5744110...>=11/20; 5x6-H 0.3106861<=1/3, 0.6893138>=2/3 with P1/2=1/2; 6x6-H 0.3792268<=2/5, 0.7737449>=3/4; 6x7-H 0.2854567<=3/10, 0.7145432>=7/10 with P1/2=1/2). Independently brute-forced crossing-count vectors for 2x2,2x3,3x3,2x6,3x4 (H and V) with independent union-find code: exact match to tm.py. Reviewed tm.py transfer-matrix logic: edge-count accounting A+(C-1)(R+A)=m, flag seeding/merging, crossed-pool (1+B)^E_new handling, base-B polynomial packing with overflow asserts — sound; slice identities across m=16..85 give strong joint check. Scope deviation (free rectangles, not 8x8 torus; 6x8..6x10 missing; 4x6 outside nominal 6..10) is explicitly disclosed as limitation, not claimed. Minor presentation overstatements do not invalidate theorem: verify.py does NOT recheck witnesses.json despite DRAFT claim of BFS recheck; run*.log absent; census_summary.json holds only 4 rows though 44 count files exist; '(exact symmetry)' gloss for P1/2=1/2 is unproved gloss but numeric equality itself is verified (total_cross=2^(m-1)). Duality XOR proved only for 3x4, but windows depend only on counts, not duality. Witness configs checked to have no H-cross (empty and single-cut full configs — trivial but valid). Exact enumeration constitutes machine-checked proof conditional on code correctness, cross-validated as above.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: nearest asymptotic theory (Zeng RSW for Z^2 site, Smirnov/Cardy-SLE scaling limits, Lawler-Schramm-Werner one-arm 5/48) gives n->infinity bounds/exponents, no fixed-n 4x6/5x6/6x6/6x7 two-sided inequalities P0.44<=a, P0.56>=b and no exact crossing-count vectors. Nearest exact-enumeration priors use same transfer-matrix family but different objects: Scullard-Jacobsen critical polynomials P_B(p) for thresholds on Archimedean lattices (bases to 96-243 edges; root estimates p_c, not free-rectangle crossing probabilities); Akhunzhanov-Eserkepov-Tarasevich exact SITE percolation polynomials to L=17 plane / L=12 torus (site vs bond, plane/cylinder/torus vs free-boundary RxC bond rectangles). No covering table of bond crossing counts c_k or P0.44/P0.56 windows for these rectangles found in live arXiv full-text/search checks; values are not mechanically implied by asymptotics or site data. Method (frontier-partition transfer matrix) is prior art, but the specific claimed numbers are new finite certificates.

value.rationale: Correct and new but an unexplained enumeration with post-hoc windows, explicitly rejectable even if correct and new. p_c=1/2 for Z^2 bond is already exactly known (Kesten); finite-size inequalities P0.44<=a<P0.56>=b for monotone crossing events are guaranteed to exist for some a<b and the quoted a,b (1/4,11/20,1/3,2/3,2/5,3/4,3/10,7/10) are just nice roundings of computed values at arbitrarily chosen p=0.44/0.56, with no theoretical consequence (no threshold localization, no RSW-constant improvement, no Cardy-formula comparison performed despite 'benchmarking' claim). Census R=2..6 x C=6..10 at p in {0.40,0.45,0.50,0.55,0.60,0.44,0.56} is an arbitrary computational frontier (6x8..6x10 missing) with no interpretation; dual-blocking 'family' is 8 trivial configs (empty + single vertical cut missing one column of horizontals), and duality XOR is shown only on 3x4, contributing no insight to the windows. Reusable tm.py pipeline is plumbing; certification alone does not create value. Notably the data contain a potentially genuine pattern (R x (R+1)-H has P1/2=1/2 exactly: verified 2x3,3x4,4x5,5x6,6x7) that could have been a theorem, but DRAFT notes two instances en passant as '(exact symmetry)' with no statement, conjecture, or proof — leaving only raw numbers. No downstream user would independently need to find these specific rectangle/p/threshold triples later.
